description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Validates the basic shape, exact selector tuples, and expression syntax of a proposed GribStream /timeseries or /runs request without sending it. Use this before returning any hand-edited curl or when changing a request from one dataset to another.

dataset.description: Dataset code, for example gfs, ifsoper, nbm, hrrr, or urma.

request.description: Request body to validate. Omit asOf unless the user explicitly asks for backtesting, time travel, what was known then, or a historical model-run cutoff for /timeseries. Use request.coordinates for point coordinates and request.variables for variable selectors.

asOf.description: Do not set asOf unless the user explicitly asks for backtesting, time travel, what was known then, or a historical model-run cutoff. Omit asOf for latest or best-available forecasts because it filters out forecast runs newer than the cutoff and can make recent data look missing. This is a UTC model-run-time cutoff for /timeseries, not a live API availability timestamp.

coordinates.description: Point coordinates. This exact field name is required. Do not use location, coord, coords, latitude/longitude at top level, or any singular replacement.

name.description: Optional coordinate label copied into the response.

expressions.description: Optional derived variables evaluated from variable aliases.

alias.description: Output field name for the expression.

expression.description: Expression text. Reference variable aliases, not raw selector names.

hidden.description: Optional: hide this expression from the response output.

filter.description: Optional row filter expression evaluated from variable aliases.

alias.description: Output field name for the expression.

expression.description: Expression text. Reference variable aliases, not raw selector names.

hidden.description: Optional: hide this expression from the response output.

forecastedFrom.description: Inclusive UTC model-run-time range start for /runs. Must be earlier than forecastedUntil; use timesList for one exact model run time.

forecastedUntil.description: Exclusive UTC model-run-time range end for /runs. Must be later than forecastedFrom; equal bounds select no times.

fromTime.description: Inclusive UTC valid-time range start for /timeseries, for example 2025-05-01T00:00:00Z. Must be earlier than untilTime; use timesList for one exact valid time.

grid.description: Optional regular latitude/longitude grid. Use this instead of or in addition to coordinates. The API preserves the requested step and does not silently coarsen fine grids. The default limit is 120000 expanded coordinates; account-specific plan or token settings may set a different maximum up to 1050000, enough for a full native 0.25-degree global GFS grid, and an oversized-response error reports the applicable maximum. Use URL delivery for dense grids before considering spatial tiling.

step.description: Requested sampling step in degrees, greater than 0. Finer sampling does not increase forecast resolution. Native latitude and longitude steps can differ; projected and unstructured grids have no single degree step.

includeMetadata.description: Optional additional row metadata: native_coordinate adds native_lat/native_lon for mapping requested sampling onto source cells; index_updated_at adds index freshness. Do not request forecasted_at or forecasted_time here; both are regular response columns returned automatically.

maxHorizon.description: Optional maximum lead time in hours.

minHorizon.description: Optional minimum lead time in hours.

timesList.description: Exact UTC valid times for /timeseries, or exact UTC model run times for /runs. Use this for one exact time instead of setting range bounds equal.

untilTime.description: Exclusive UTC valid-time range end for /timeseries, for example 2025-05-01T06:00:00Z. Must be later than fromTime; equal bounds select no times.

variables.description: Variable selectors. This exact field name is required. Do not use parameters, parameter, variable, selector, or selectors. Values must be exact case-sensitive selector tuples discovered from catalog tools.

alias.description: Optional response field name. Strongly recommended.

hidden.description: Optional: hide intermediate variables used only by expressions.

info.description: Exact info string. Use an empty string when the catalog selector has no info value.

level.description: Exact level string, for example 2 m above ground.

name.description: Exact case-sensitive parameter short name, for example TMP.

name: gribstream_validate_request

valid.description: Whether the request body passed local shape, selector, and expression checks.

title: Validate API request
